force_convention: top boundary carries a uniform compressive traction of magnitude q_L over width a (quarter Mandel, a=1) or 2a (full domain, a=1); expected top resultant is -a*q_L (quarter) or -2*a*q_L (full).
reference_note: The rotated-anisotropy runs use DEFAULT_CS with phi_s0=0.6 and K=7, while the Mandel reference is the reference-modulus isotropic problem of the quarter-domain decks (phi_s0=0.9, K=1, G=0.75, alpha=0.6). A Mandel-normalized discrepancy would compare different problems, so no reference-normalized field is emitted; only the run diagnostics (mass balance, force balance, platen equality, peak pressure) are reported.
